name: PT Citra Putra Realty Tbk
summary: PT Citra Putra Realty Tbk engages in hospitality business in Indonesia. The company operates through three segments: Rent Room, Food and Beverage, and Other Departments. It owns and operates The Stones Legian Hotel located in Bali and Clay Hotel located in Jakarta. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia. PT Citra Putra Realty Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Citra Putra Mandiri.
